data.description:
## Description

**What**: Create `plugins/dso/scripts/telemetry/aws-setup-lambda.sh` that provisions: (a) IAM execution role with `s3:PutObject` ONLY on the bucket from `aws-setup-bucket.sh`, (b) Python 3.13 Lambda with placeholder handler, (c) Lambda Function URL (no API Gateway), (d) reserved-concurrency=10, (e) CloudWatch log group with 7-day retention. Pre-flight IAM permission check. Idempotent. Writes `review_telemetry.lambda_function_name`, `review_telemetry.iam_role_name`, `review_telemetry.endpoint_url` to `.claude/dso-config.conf`.
**Why**: Pairs with `aws-setup-bucket.sh` to complete walking-skeleton AWS provisioning. Resource-name persistence to config unblocks the 7-command live verification in sc-10.
**Scope**:
- IN: Lambda function, IAM execution role (s3:PutObject on bucket only), Function URL, reserved-concurrency=10, CloudWatch log group (7-day retention), config-key writes.
- OUT: Lambda handler code (separate story). Bucket creation (aws-setup-bucket.sh).

## Done Definitions

- When this story is complete, running `aws-setup-lambda.sh` creates a Python 3.13 Lambda with Function URL, reserved-concurrency=10, IAM execution role limited to `s3:PutObject` on the telemetry bucket, and CloudWatch log group with 7-day retention.
  ← Satisfies: sc-1  (sc-1: "Lambda with Function URL, IAM role s3:PutObject only, reserved-concurrency cap, CloudWatch log group 7-day retention")
- When this story is complete, re-running `aws-setup-lambda.sh` after a successful first run is a no-op — no resources are recreated or updated.
  ← Satisfies: sc-1
- When this story is complete, `.claude/dso-config.conf` contains `review_telemetry.lambda_function_name`, `review_telemetry.iam_role_name`, and `review_telemetry.endpoint_url` with the provisioned resource identifiers.
  ← Satisfies: sc-10  (sc-10: "resource names written to dso-config.conf by aws-setup-*.sh scripts")
- When this story is complete, `aws iam simulate-principal-policy` for the Lambda execution role against `s3:PutObject` on the telemetry bucket returns `EvalDecision=allowed`.
  ← Satisfies: sc-10
- When this story is complete, missing operator IAM permissions for Lambda or IAM creation produce a clear pre-flight error before any resource is created.
  ← Satisfies: sc-1

## Considerations

- [Ordering] IAM role must be created and propagated before Lambda is created — include a propagation wait or retry-with-backoff.
- [Least privilege] Execution role must NOT include broader S3 permissions; restrict ARN to the specific bucket.
- [Idempotency] Use `get-function` / `get-role` checks; update only when configuration drifts.
- [Config dependency] Reads `review_telemetry.bucket_name` from dso-config.conf; fail clearly if absent.
- [Python 3.13 pre-flight] Verify `python3.13` runtime is available in us-east-1 before attempting function creation. Exit 1 with clear error if unavailable rather than failing mid-execution with partial resources.

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
data.title: As an operator, I want aws-setup-lambda.sh to provision the Lambda function, IAM role, Function URL, reserved concurrency, and CloudWatch log group idempotently, writing resource names to dso-config.conf.
